terms.meta.title: Terms of Service
terms.meta.description: Terms of Service of Qualisoft Co., Ltd. governing the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between the Company and users.
terms.head.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1.title: Article 1 (Purpose)
terms.s1.body: The purpose of these Terms of Service (hereinafter referred to as the "Terms") is to stipulate the rights, obligations, responsibilities, and other necessary matters between Qualisoft Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") and users in connection with the use of services provided by the Company.
terms.s2.title: Article 2 (Definitions)
terms.s2.p1: 1. "Services" means the websites, applications, software, and all related services provided by the Company.
terms.s2.p2: 2. "User" means any person or entity that uses the Services provided by the Company in accordance with these Terms.
terms.s3.toc: Validity and Amendment of the Terms
terms.s3.title: Article 3 (Validity and Amendment of the Terms)
terms.s3.p1: 1. These Terms apply to all Users who wish to use the Services.
terms.s3.p2: 2. The Company may amend these Terms where necessary to the extent that such amendments do not violate applicable laws and regulations, and any amended Terms shall be notified to Users through appropriate means, such as an announcement within the Services or via e-mail.
terms.s4.title: Article 4 (Disclaimer of Liability)
terms.s4.body: The Company shall not be liable for any interruption or failure of the Services caused by force majeure events, including natural disasters, hacking, or telecommunications failures.
